payload.title: 15 Best Crete Wedding Venues
payload.excerpt: Crete wedding venues sit in four areas: Elounda and Agios Nikolaos in the east, Hersonissos and the Heraklion coast, Rethymno, and Chania and the west.
key_takeaways: Choose the area before the venue, because an east Crete wedding flies guests into Heraklion while a Chania wedding suits Chania airport.
Guest count narrows the list fast: Avra Imperial and Elounda Beach publish space for several hundred, while Euphoria's packages are built for up to 30 guests.
Exclusive use can mean a chosen space rather than the whole hotel, and curfews and minimum nights are rarely published, so get them in writing before you pay a deposit.
A legal wedding needs documents prepared weeks ahead, and a summer date means planning around heat and wildfire season.

faq.q: Which part of Crete is best for a wedding?
faq.a: It depends on your guests. The east, around Elounda and Agios Nikolaos, has resort chapels and bay views and is about 50 minutes from Heraklion Airport. The west, around Chania, has the old town and the widest range, from a hall for 680 to packages for up to 30.

faq.q: Can we book a Crete wedding venue for exclusive use?
faq.a: Sometimes. Sea View by En Kipo is yours alone from 10am until midnight. Nana Princess gives exclusive use of the chosen space for symbolic weddings. Most resorts do not publish a whole-hotel option, so ask each one in writing.

faq.q: Which airport should our guests fly into for a Crete wedding?
faq.a: Heraklion for the east and centre, Chania for the west. Minos Beach and Minos Palace are about 50 minutes from Heraklion and about three hours from Chania.

faq.q: Which months and ceremony times suit a Crete wedding?
faq.a: April to November, with a later ceremony as summer heats up. Minos Palace describes the weather in eastern Crete as pleasant from April to November. In April, May and October, Nana Princess recommends ceremonies from 4pm to 6pm; in July and August, 6.30pm to 8pm, because of the heat. Wildfires occur from June to September, and heatwaves are frequent over summer.

faq.q: Can Australians legally get married in Crete?
faq.a: Yes. Venues such as Elounda Peninsula offer civil and Greek Orthodox packages, and the documents can include a Certificate of No Impediment. A marriage valid in Greece is in most cases recognised in Australia.

faq.q: Are there beach wedding venues in Crete?
faq.a: Yes. Nana Princess holds civil weddings on its private beach, Amirandes holds ceremonies on its VIP Beach for up to 80 guests, and Euphoria offers informal weddings with a choice of beach settings.
